what_changed_recently.headline: Tariff Hike Flow-Through and Minimal Churn
what_changed_recently.detail: The industry-wide tariff hike implementation was completed with minimal churn (< 1.8%), with the full flow-through expected to reflect in subsequent quarters.

what_changed_recently.headline: Rights Call Money Collection of ₹15,695.97 Cr
what_changed_recently.detail: Successfully collected ₹15,695.97 Cr (over ₹156.9 billion) through the final call on partly paid equity shares, strengthening the balance sheet and enabling debt retirement.

what_changed_recently.headline: Domestic Capex Moderation Guidance for FY27
what_changed_recently.detail: Management guided domestic telecom capex lower by 15-20% to ₹25,000-28,000 Cr as capex intensity peaks, driving sustained free cash flow generation.

growth_drivers.description: Large-scale expansion in the data center business to build 1 GW of capacity over the coming years, expanding from the current 220+ MW footprint.
growth_drivers.execution_status: 120 MW under active construction with 90% pre-commitment
growth_drivers.expected_impact: Capitalize on robust demand from hyperscalers and domestic enterprises, particularly in Mumbai.
growth_drivers.source_quote: Nxtra Data Limited (data centre arm) also reported strong 17% revenue growth led by capacity augmentation. During the year, the company announced large-scale expansion in its data centre business, with plans to build 1 GW of capacity over the coming years.

growth_drivers.driver_title: Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) & FTTH Homes Expansion
growth_drivers.description: Scaling connected homes via hybrid fiber and 5G FWA (AirFiber) to capture high-margin, sticky fixed-line broadband revenue.
growth_drivers.execution_status: FWA live in 3,300+ cities; reached 10 Million Wi-Fi/FTTH home broadband connections milestone
growth_drivers.expected_impact: Targeting 25 Million connected homes by FY28, expanding broadband segment ARR at 25%+ YoY with 50%+ EBITDA margins.
growth_drivers.source_quote: FWA continued to expand the addressable market, with Airtel’s offerings now live in over 3,300 cities. In FTTH, the Company expanded its reach to 159 cities, taking its presence to 1,635 cities.

promise_vs_delivery.management_promise: Zero net debt in domestic standalone entity within 3 years.
promise_vs_delivery.promise_quote: Zero net debt in domestic standalone entity within 3 years.
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Standalone borrowings reduced to ₹950,716 million (₹854,411m non-current + ₹96,305m current) as of March 31, 2026, with cash and cash equivalents at ₹69,578 million. Net debt is not yet zero.
promise_vs_delivery.actual_quote: Borrowings [Non-current] 854,411... Borrowings [Current] 96,305... Cash and cash equivalents 69,578
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: Standalone net debt has reduced significantly but is not yet zero due to ongoing spectrum liabilities and capex requirements. However, leverage ratios have improved dramatically.
promise_vs_delivery.financial_numbers_check: Standalone borrowings decreased from ₹1,108,396 million (₹902,801m non-current + ₹205,595m current) in FY25 to ₹950,716 million in FY26, a reduction of 14.2% YoY. Operating cash flow (CFO) for the consolidated entity grew from ₹98,332 Cr in FY25 to ₹122,230 Cr in FY26 (a 24.3% increase).

promise_vs_delivery.area: Net Debt to EBITDA Leverage Target
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Consolidated Net Debt to EBITDAaL ratio improved to 0.8x as of March 31, 2026 (or 1.1x net debt-to-equity ratio).
promise_vs_delivery.actual_quote: The net debt-to-EBITDAaL ratio improved to 0.8x from 1.5x as of March 31, 2025
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: Management has comfortably delivered on this target, driven by strong operating cash flows, rights issue call money collection, and prepayment of high-cost DoT spectrum liabilities.
promise_vs_delivery.financial_numbers_check: Consolidated borrowings in the audited balance sheet decreased from ₹2,13,642 Cr in FY25 to ₹1,95,412 Cr in FY26, a reduction of ₹18,230 Cr (8.5% YoY). Consolidated CFO grew to ₹1,22,230 Cr in FY26.

demand_momentum.summary: Demand remains robust across premium mobile subscribers, home broadband, and enterprise digital services. Premiumization is driving ARPU growth, with postpaid additions hitting record highs. FWA and FTTH are seeing strong traction, though FWA acquisition quality is being tightened. Enterprise demand is shifting from traditional connectivity to digital services like IoT, Cloud, and Cybersecurity.

company_specific_metrics.value: Crossed 45 Million users representing 12.5% of mobile base

segment_trends.value: Revenues rose by 13.2% YoY in Q2'26 to ₹281,167 Mn, with ARPU at ₹256.
Revenue grew 30.2% YoY in Q2'26 to ₹18,646 Mn, with customer base reaching 11.9 Mn.
EBITDA grew 8.6% YoY to ₹21,943 Mn in Q2'26, with EBITDA margin expanding to 41.6%.

demand_momentum.market_share_and_pricing: Market share in premium >₹500/month ARPU accounts reached 42% in India. Lifetime high revenue market share achieved. Pricing power is strong, with the recent tariff hike successfully implemented with minimal churn (<1.8%).
headwinds_and_risks: Elevated network operating expenses during rollout
demand_momentum.source_quote: The Company’s focus on portfolio premiumisation and high-quality customer acquisition continued to support industry-leading ARPU, which rose to ₹257 from ₹245 in the previous year.

risks_and_cash.working_capital_and_receivables: Trade receivables turnover ratio stood at 10 days in FY25 (vs 9 days in FY24). Trade receivables stood at ₹28,935 million on standalone basis in FY26. Credit period generally ranges from 14-30 days, and 7-90 days for Airtel Business.
risks_and_cash.debt_and_capex_burden: Consolidated borrowings stood at ₹1,95,412 Cr in FY26, down from ₹2,13,642 Cr in FY25. Standalone borrowings stood at ₹950,716 million in FY26. Capex for FY26 was ₹475,218 million. Prepayment of high-cost DoT debt of ₹658,083 million since FY22 has optimized interest costs.
risks_and_cash.margin_and_cost_pressures: Operating leverage and 'War on Waste' program have driven EBITDAaL margin expansion to 51.4% in FY26 (vs 49.0% in FY25). However, currency devaluation in Nigeria (NGN) remains a key headwind for the Africa business.
execution_and_bottlenecks: FWA unit economics challenged by rising memory and chipset pricing, leading to a strategic pivot to fiber
Erratic last-mile IT connectivity in some geographies
Delays in equipment supply or partner dependencies
regulatory_or_legal_headwinds: Escalating spectrum prices and regulatory levies
Sub-judice matters including AGR dues and license fee disputes
risks_and_cash.source_quote: Since FY 2021-22, the company has proactively prepaid ₹658,083 million of high-cost DoT debt , carrying coupon rates between 8.65% and 10%, reflecting its sharp focus on optimising the cost of capital.

positive_triggers: Full flow-through of recent tariff hikes over the next 2 quarters
Moderation of domestic capex by 15-20% in FY27 driving massive FCF generation
London listing of Airtel Money in H2 2026
Scaling up of Nxtra Data Centers to 1 GW capacity
main_risks: Regulatory changes or adverse rulings on sub-judice AGR/license fee matters
what_to_watch_next: FWA precision deployment and FTTH net additions recovery
NBFC lending scale-up and delinquency rates
EBITDA margin sustainability around 53-54% in domestic business
stocker_view.investor_summary: Bharti Airtel is demonstrating stellar execution, transitioning from a pure-play telco to a diversified digital services giant. The peaking of 5G capex, combined with the flow-through of tariff hikes and rights issue cash infusion, is driving a massive inflection in free cash flow and rapid deleveraging (Net Debt/EBITDA down to 0.8x). With high-growth engines like Nxtra Data Centers, Airtel Payments Bank, and the upcoming Airtel Money London listing, the company offers a highly resilient, compounding growth profile with expanding return ratios (ROCE > 20%).

key_takeaways: Record consolidated EBITDA with margin expansion driven by premium subscriber transitions.

Rapid deleveraging with Net Debt/EBITDA contracting below 2.0x.
